name: easyprintBD (NEXA Print)
what: Pay-per-page self-service printing: a customer scans the QR sticker on a printer, uploads a file, pays with bKash and collects the pages, with no account needed.
hard_part: MySQL is also the job queue (SELECT … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), so a job claim happens in the same transaction as its payment record. A printer that drops out mid-job goes to a reconciling state and the page counter decides what printed, so a jam at page 9 of 24 refunds only the unprinted pages.
demo_note: the print flow opens by scanning a printer's QR sticker; /p/ alone only explains that
facts: Files go straight to S3 by presigned upload; the server counts pages itself
Live job progress over server-sent events
Unprinted jobs expire after 30 minutes with a full refund
Linux print agent pulls work over HTTPS and prints through CUPS
